correctness.rationale: H_n uses a involutive swap of 1,n and b with collision {2,n}. b is the sole rank-reducing letter. Every b omits n; to make a later b effective, a must restore n from state 1, forcing state 1 then absent and the previous b to leave both 2,n absent; another drop after the second requires b to restore 2, then a to restore n, then effective b. Thus initial b followed by the minimal ab and thereafter bab blocks gives length 3s−3 for s≥2, with rigid unique equality word (bab)^(s−1). Inducting the holes {n,2,4,...,2r}, including the even-n n↔1 transition, yields h=floor(n/2)+1 and saturation immediately after. Independent subset BFS n4..13 checked uniqueness and the next deficiency; packaged verifier BFS n4..14 and replay to 300 was source-read, not assumed sufficient for all n.
residual_risks: n≥4, s1 and 2≤s≤floor(n/2)+1; first-next-deficiency statement only when h+1≤n−1; not the full quadratic reset threshold.
Finite BFS checks only n=4..13 for automata; all-n correctness rests on the symbolic proof, not those samples.
